lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a non-uniform grid arrangement with larger, higher-luminance spots situated along the mid-flank and smaller, higher-density clusters near the dorsal margin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the larger lateral blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient with high-reflectance highlights on the superior edges and defined shadow casting on the inferior edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Five deep, parallel vertical lacerations are present across the gill region, characterized by significant tissue indentation and loss of pigment, extending from the upper flank towards the ventral margin.
